patthana2.3:222.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- āsavasampayuttādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Domanassasahagatādhipati mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:223.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca . . . Sahajātā āsavasampayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Domanassasahagatādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:224.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati:-- dānaṃ sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ . . . taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni . . . jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ . . . Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ . . . Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati:-- āsavavippayuttādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.3:225.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇādhipati:-- dānaṃ sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati . . . pe . . . pubbe suciṇṇāni . . . jhānā . . . cakkhuṃ . . . vatthuṃ āsavavippayutte khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti . . . pe . . . uppajjati. 1.
patthana2.3:226.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā āsavasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.3:227.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa . . . Purimā purimā domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa domanassa-vicikicchāuddhaccasahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āsavasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:228.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca . . . Purimā purimā domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:229.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa . . . Purimo purimo domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagato moho pacchimassa pacchimassa domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatassa mohassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā āsavavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo, 5.
patthana2.3:230.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa . . . Purimo purimo domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.3:231.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca . . . Purimo purimo domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagato moho pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 7.
patthana2.3:232.1: Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa . . . Purimā purimā domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassavicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.3:233.1: Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavavippayuttassa . . . Purimā purimā . . . pe . . . moho ca pacchimassa . . . Domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.3:234.1: Āsavasampayutto ca āsavavippayutto ca dhammā āsavasampayuttassa ca āsavavippayuttassa ca . . . Purimā purimā domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassavicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.3:235.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo . . . sahajātāpaccayena paccayo (nava) . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (cha) . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo (nava) . . .
patthana2.3:236.1: upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.3:237.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- āsavasampayuttā khandhā āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:238.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Anantarūpanissayo . . . pe . . . āsavasampayuttā khandhā domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:239.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . paññaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, senāsanaṃ mohaṃ upanissāya samāpattiṃ uppādeti, saddhā . . . pe . . . paññā, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ moho ca saddhāya mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.3:240.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo; . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ ūpanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . paññaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ utuṃ bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ mohaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; saddhā ca moho ca rāgassa . . . pe . . . patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.3:241.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo; . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhā sīlaṃ moho domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 7.
patthana2.3:242.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Anantarūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca āsavasampayuttānañ ca khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo (pucchitabbaṃ mūlaṃ). Domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.3:243.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Anantarūpanissayo . . . pe . . . moho ca domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānañ ca mohassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:244.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ: -- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa . . . Vatthupurejāta:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu āsavavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.3:245.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ āssadeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.3:246.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Ārammaṇapurejātan . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ ārabbha domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.3:247.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:248.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Pacchājātā āsavavippayuttā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.3:249.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Pacchājātā domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.3:250.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo . . . (nava. Āvajjanā pi vuṭṭhānam pi natthi). 1.
patthana2.3:251.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Āsavasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.3:252.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā āsavasampayuttā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā āsavasampayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā cetanā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:253.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Āsavasampayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:254.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā āsavavippayuttā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā āsavavippayuttā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:255.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 1.
patthana2.3:256.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Āsavasampayuttā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.3:257.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Āsavasampayuttā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā āhārā mohassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:258.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Āsavasampayuttā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:259.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Āsavavippayuttā āhārā . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.3:260.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . (cattāri) . . . jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (cattāri) . . . maggapaccayena paccayo . . . (cattāri) . . . sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (cha). 2.
patthana2.3:261.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavavippayuttassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.3:262.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ, vitthāretabbaṃ). 5.
patthana2.3:263.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Purejātaṃ:-- vatthu āsavasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.3:264.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Purejātaṃ:-- vatthu domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhaccasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ mohassa ca vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.3:265.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.3:266.1: Āsavasampayutto dhammo āsavasampayuttassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 2.
patthana2.3:267.1: Āsavasampayutto . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Domanassa-vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā mohassa ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. 3.
patthana2.3:269.1: Āsavavippayutto dhammo āsavavipayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ, vitthāretabbaṃ). 5.
patthana2.3:270.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto domanassa-, vicikicchā-, uddhacca-sahagato moho sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā, uddhaccaṃ, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthu āsavasampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.3:271.1: Āsavavippayutto . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Sahajātaṃ . . . pe . . . khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ ārabbha domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca uppajjanti. 7.
patthana2.3:272.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavasampayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto āsavasampayutto eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve . . . Domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhaccasahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve . . . 8.
patthana2.3:273.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavavippayuttassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ domanassa-vicikicchā-uddhacca-sahagatā khandhā ca moho ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Domanassa- vicikicchā-uddhaccasahagatā khandhā ca vatthu ca mohassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā āsavasampayuttā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana2.3:274.1: Āsavasampayutto ca . . . āsavasampayuttassa ca . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto domanassa-vicikicchāuddhacca-sahagato eko khandho ca moho ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve . . . pe . . .
